# TopTierPrep re-walk (2026-09-23): what the teardown was missing

I went through the site in Dia. Some things could not be seen on screen: their plan generator failed every time, and my tab kept going to the background because tab 1332440635 kept taking focus. For those parts I read their shipped JS bundles and API responses instead. Anything marked **(bundle)** comes from their code, not from a screen. I closed all my tabs.

## 1. Study plan (priority 1)

**No plan exists. The generator failed 3 times out of 3.** Two attempts were exam Oct 3 with 1h/day. One was exam Nov 7 with 1.5h/day and 4 focus areas plus 1 strong.
- The server marks the plan `status:"FAILED"` about 0.3s after `POST /api/study-plans/generate`. The UI still plays a fake progress screen.
- Build screen copy: "Building your study plan", "This usually takes about a minute. You can leave this page and come back — it keeps building."
- It shows a % bar and 5 checklist steps, each with its own sub-line:
  1. Reading your scores and target
  2. Mapping the weeks to your exam ("Laying out every study day and leaving your days off clear")
  3. Choosing what to work on each day ("Weighting your weak areas heaviest, easing off your strengths")
  4. Balancing your daily study time ("Making sure no day runs longer than you said you can manage")
  5. Almost there
- Error card: "We could not build your plan", "Nothing was charged against your plan allowance. Try again, and if it keeps failing, give it a few minutes before your next attempt." and a [Try again] button.
- Try again sends you back to step 1 with the draft reset: the exam date goes back to the profile date and the time goes back to 1h. So "draft saves as you go" does not survive a failure.
- Failed plans are hidden from "Your study plans" and the landing still says "1 plan left this cycle". The API does list them as FAILED, versions 1–3.

**Wizard details the teardown lacks:**
- Step 1 prefills from `/exam-sessions/results/overview` and `/qbank/stats`. It uses measured scores only if tests exist and both sections are above 200.
- Step 2 exam date is a free calendar popover (any date, not just official SAT dates). The pace line updates live, e.g. "7 weeks to prepare · about 60 points per week".
- A hidden screen-reader line reads "Starting score 1000, target score 1400, projected gain 400 points."
- Step 3 time chips map to 30/60/90/120/150/180/240 minutes. The at-a-glance summary rounds up: 1.5h × 5 days shows as "8 hours across 5 days".
- Step 4: once 4 areas are on Focus, the other Focus buttons grey out. Helper text: "4 focus areas is the maximum. Move one back to Normal to pick a different one."
- Focus rows get a blue tint and Strong rows a green one. Each section header keeps a count, e.g. "2 focus · 1 strong".
- Stepper tiles do not let you jump forward.

**Plan data model (API):** `{status: BUILDING|ACTIVE|COMPLETED|REPLACED|FAILED, version, currentScoreRW/Math, targetScoreRW/Math, examDate, dailyStudyTime, weeklyStudyDays, weakAreas[], strengths[], vocabularyPreference, dailyPracticeExam, offDays[], totalTasks, completedTasks, weeks[{weekNumber, theme, days[{date, isOffDay, tasks[{type, title, duration, domain, aiReason, completed, skipped, order}]}]}]}`

**Endpoints (bundle):** generate, latest, list, get, activate, delete, createTask, updateTask, removeTask, moveTask (`PUT tasks/move`), completeTask (`{performance}`), skipTask, startTask, progress, analytics, regenerate, adapt.

**Plan view once it exists (bundle, not seen on screen):**
- **Page tabs:** Plan | Progress | History.
- **4 stat tiles:**
  - Days to exam (hint "Keep the streak going", or "Exam day has arrived")
  - Streak (hint "Longest N days")
  - Plan complete % (hint "X of Y tasks")
  - Score gap (hint "1000 now, 1400 target")
- **Today card:**
  - "Today" chip and the date.
  - "N of M done · X min left · Y min planned".
  - Empty states: "Rest day" / "You marked this as a day off. Rest is part of the plan." or "No tasks scheduled" / "Nothing is scheduled for today. Check the week below to work ahead."
- **Task card:**
  - Title; type badge; "N min"; · domain; · destination.
  - Type labels: Practice test / Question set / Vocabulary / Reading / Practice game / Flashcards / Custom.
  - Destinations: Practice exam / Question bank / Vocab quiz / Vocabulary / Flashcards / On your own.
  - "Skipped" outline badge.
  - "Why this task?" expands to `aiReason` (label flips to "Hide AI rationale").
- **Task actions:**
  - Open task: [Skip] (ghost), [Mark done] (outline), and a primary launch button per type: Start test / Start questions / Study words / Start reading / Play / Review cards.
  - CUSTOM tasks only get [Mark done], with "Work through this one on your own, then mark it done."
  - Done task: "✓ Done" badge, [Practice again], [Undo].
- **Week view:**
  - "Week N", "X of Y tasks · Z%", the week's `theme` sentence and a progress bar.
  - Pager ‹ "3 / 7" ›, plus a [This week] jump when you are elsewhere.
  - 7 day tiles: weekday, date, and "done/total", "rest" or "—". Today has a top accent bar; the selected day is filled.
- **Selected day:**
  - Header "Today, Wednesday, September 23".
  - Empty day: "Nothing scheduled", "No tasks on this day. Pick another day above, or move one here."
- **Task rows in the week:**
  - A checkbox ("Mark as done" / "Mark as not done").
  - The aiReason shown inline.
  - A ⋯ menu ("More actions for {title}") with "Move to" and the later days of the same week ("Thursday, Sep 24"), or "No later day this week".
  - A launch button, which becomes [Redo] once done.
  - Skipped rows drop to 55% opacity.
  - **Rescheduling = move a task to a later day in the same week only.**
- **Adaptive banners:**
  - Behind: shown when there were at least 4 tasks in the last 7 days and under 60% got done. Copy: "You have fallen behind this week", "N tasks done over the last 7 days. We can rebuild the weeks ahead around the time you actually have — finished work stays untouched." [Rebalance my plan]
  - Score drift: shown when measured R&W + Math beats the plan's starting score by at least 60. Heading is "Your practice scores are up N points", or "You have hit your target score". Body: "This plan was built around X, but your recent tests average Y. Rebuilding uses your real scores…" [Not now] / [Rebuild with these scores].
  - "Not now" snoozes for 3h in localStorage. Only upward drift triggers it.
- **Progress tab:**
  - "Accuracy by domain": horizontal bars, "Weakest first. This is where your remaining time pays off most.", with an RW/MATH legend.
  - "Study time": "Study time per day", "hours logged across N days", Studied vs Planned.
  - "How your plan splits your time": "Planned minutes by task type across the whole plan."
  - Empty state: "Nothing logged yet".
- **History tab:** "Your plans", "Every plan you have built. Open any of them to look around, or switch your active plan without losing the others."
  - Rows show status badge, Built / Exam / Days left / Tasks, "you are here", [Open] / [Make active].
  - Older plan banner: "You are viewing an older plan", "… · not your active plan", [Back to active plan] / [Make this my plan].
  - Footer: "Need a different plan? … This plan stays available under History." [New plan].
  - Toasts: Task skipped / added / updated / removed, "Your remaining weeks have been rebalanced", "Switched to this plan", "Study plan archived".
- **Dashboard card when a plan exists (bundle):**
  - "Today's Plan", with an "All Done 🎉" badge when finished.
  - "N of M completed", "X min left (Y min total)" or "All time targets reached".
  - A [Full Plan →] button and checkbox rows ("Mark task as done").
  - Error toast: "Could not start task. Please try again."

## 2. Results list and score report (priority 2)

**/results list:**
- Card: "Paper #47", "COMPLETED: 8H AGO", then per-module rows ("R&W Module 1", "Math Module 1") of red chips for wrong **and unanswered** items together ("2 3 4 5 6 7 +19"), then a full-width [Review].
- **No score on the card**, although the list API returns composite/RW/Math.
- The chips are plain spans (not clickable).
- Pages of 10 with Previous/Next.
- **"Share / Export Report" has no click handler (dead button).**
- The Score Overview card only renders "Total Estimated Score: / Math / English" after a full test.

**Report /results/{id}:**
- The numbers count up on load.
- The gauge text "2 Correct, 25 Wrong" counts unanswered as wrong. The API says wrong 0 / unanswered 25, and the Performance Summary on the same page says 0 Incorrect / 45 Unanswered, so the page contradicts itself.
- Accuracy 8.2% = 4/49.
- **Domain cards:** "13% · 13% of test section, 1-8 questions" really means 1 of 8 correct.
- The 7-segment bar is `level 0–7`. The API also returns a per-domain `domainScore` that the UI never shows.
- **Percentile (bundle):** "N% scored at or below you on their {first} attempt." It appears only for ranked sittings; this one showed "Practice test — not ranked" (`ranked:false`, attemptNumber 1).
- **Question grid:** green = correct, grey = unanswered, flagged = dot. Filters: All / R&W / Math / Flagged (n). Legend: Correct / Incorrect / Unanswered / Flagged for review (1).
- **Review modal:**
  - Header "R&W - M1 · Q1" with chips "Correct" / "Unanswered" and "Flagged for review".
  - Buttons: [Hide answers] / [Report] / "1 of 49" / Close.
  - Body: passage, stem, choices, YOUR ANSWER box ("Unanswered" when blank), CORRECT ANSWER box.
  - The explanation is "Justification:" followed by "Distractor Analysis:" with one line per wrong option.
  - ← → arrow keys move between questions.
  - Hide answers → "Answers hidden" chip; the key box and explanation disappear; the button becomes [Show answers]; the state **persists across Next**. You still cannot re-answer.
- **The per-question payload has no domain, skill, difficulty or time spent**, so the report cannot say which skill or how long.
- "Custom Set · 2 Modules" does not count as a test: the Paper #47 card still says "Your last score: Not taken" and Exam Attempts is 0/1.

## 3. QBank session (priority 3)

- **Builder:**
  - "Marked for Review" options are **All / Saved Only**, so "mark for review" is the save list.
  - Solved: All / Solved Only / Unsolved Only.
  - Unchecking a domain does not update the "N questions" count (1921 stayed 1921).
- **Details popover:** QUESTION ID `06469-DC`, DOMAIN "Problem-Solving & Data Analysis", SKILL "Percentages", DIFFICULTY "Easy". It does not show the 1–7 Question Score.
- **Attempt History modal:** "#1 ⊗ Incorrect · Option A · 00:22 · Sep 23, 11:35 AM" and [Close]. Empty state: "No attempts yet."
- **After checking:**
  - Wrong: red border and tint.
  - Right: green border, filled letter and a ✓ icon. Check stays enabled.
  - SPR correct turns the input green. The Answer Preview renders fractions in KaTeX (55/4 as a stacked fraction).
- **Question Overview:**
  - Status legend: Unanswered (outline), Correct, Incorrect, **Mixed = square split diagonally green/red**, Marked (yellow), Current (blue, which overrides the other states).
  - Difficulty view: tinted squares, Easy green / Medium blue / Hard red.
- **Reload behaviour:** the per-question stopwatch resets to 00:00, and the earlier wrong pick comes back as a plain blue "selected" (not red).
- Untimed mode shows an "Untimed" pill where the timer sits.
- The vocab FAB still covers Next.
- **From the bundle:**
  - Share creates a *shared session* (`/question-bank/shared/:shareId`, with a "Start Practice" landing). Toasts: "Share link copied to clipboard" / "Share created (id: …)".
  - Annotate mode on passages ("Annotating — click to stop", Note / Save note / Remove).
  - Eliminations are saved to the server.
  - Clear Session confirm: "This removes answers, annotations, and attempts from this session only. Your question-bank progress from other sessions is kept."
  - Timed sessions have "Go to Review Page →", "Check Your Work" and "Submit Module".
  - The API has toggleRedo / toggleSaved / finishSession, but **there is no Redo button in the session UI**. Profile shows "Redo Questions 0".

## 4. Dashboard with data (priority 4)

- QOTD card shows a "🔥1 day" streak pill.
- Study time: "1m STUDY TIME TODAY / 1h 13m THIS MONTH".
- Calendar: days with activity are filled blue (the 22nd), today is black (the 23rd). The sitting finished 22:14 UTC, so this is a UTC-versus-local display issue, not an off-by-one. The Recent Tests card dates the same sitting 23/09/2026.
- Recent Tests card: "TOTAL SCORE · 23/09/2026 · 420 · R&W 200 · Math 220 · [Review]".
- Score Progress still reads 0 ("Complete a full-length test…"). Target Score is 0 even though the wizard set 1400; they are not synced.
- Target pencil opens a "Set Target Score" modal: "SAT scores range from 400 to 1600. Your current score is 1460." (wrong number), a big number input with placeholder 1500, a 400–1600 bar, [Cancel] / [Save Score], disabled until you type.
- Exam-date pill is a select of official dates that includes past ones: Aug 22 2026, Sept 12, Oct 3, Nov 7, Dec 5, Mar 6 2027, May 1, Jun 5.
- Greeting switches between Morning / Afternoon / Evening.

## 5. Profile, achievements, preferences (priority 5)

- **Stat tiles:** Streak 0 Days (while QOTD says 1 day), Tests 1 Taken, Solved 57 Qs, Vocab 2 Words.
- **Other cards:** Global Rank 128 / Country Rank 43 (with no contests played); Saved Words 0 / Redo Questions 0 / Saved Questions 1.
- **Study Goals:** Target Not set, Exam Date "10 days remaining", Daily 2 Hours / Weekly 12 Hours / Preferred Time Evening.
- **Achievements are 4 hard-coded tiles** (7-Day Streak, 1000 Solved, Consistency, Top Rank) with no progress or earned state. **"View All" has no handler.**
- **Learning Preferences:** Practice Mode Timed/Untimed; Difficulty Level **Adaptive/Fixed**; switches AI Explanations, Show Desmos Calculator, Include Vocab Review.
- **Recent Activity:** "Custom Set · 2 Modules · 8h ago ›".
- **Account (bundle):** name and email editable inline; avatar upload / replace / remove ("Remove profile photo? Your initials will be shown instead…"); Set or Change Password (at least 8 characters, confirm). Plan badges include "Trialing" and "Teacher Seat".

## 6. Practice catalog (priority 6)

- **Estimated Score card with data:** "Math 200-280" / "LOW CONFIDENCE" (red) / "Math estimate only. Practice Reading & Writing to see your total score range."
- It comes from `summary {status: PARTIAL, sections {math {average 220, min 200, max 280, attempts 1}}, confidence {level, label, reason}, trend {direction, delta}, headline}`.
- R&W is ignored because it sat at the 200 floor, even though R&W was practised.
- 31 cards now. "People took" is abbreviated ("1.6k").
- Hidden route `/practice/diagnostic`: the same filters without Type, and "No diagnostic tests match the selected filters." Nothing links to it.

## 7. Contests and leaderboards (priority 7)

- Still empty and nothing is live. Copy is identical to the teardown.
- **Rules copy (bundle):**
  - Types Daily / Weekly / Seasonal; tiers Pro / Elite.
  - "Correct answers earn points by difficulty, plus a speed bonus based on the time you spend on each question."
  - "The contest runs in fullscreen. Switching tabs, leaving fullscreen, copying or pasting voids the answer to the question you're on."
  - "One attempt per contest. Answers are revealed after the contest ends."
- **Resumes are limited** ("This attempt was scored 0 because the resume limit was exceeded").
- Per-contest stats: Score / Correct / Incorrect / Skipped / Voided. Also "Anonymous student" names and "under pressure" time analysis.

## 8. Vocabulary (priority 8)

- **Quiz:** a correct pick tints that tile green and fades the others; a [Next] pill appears.
- No "Correct" text, no running score, no question count, no end of session.

## Hidden features not in the teardown (bundle and routes)

- **Classes / homework:** `/my-classes` shows "My Classes · Pick a class to see its homework. · You're not in any class yet. Your teacher will add you to one." It is not in the sidebar.
- Assignments run as "a full practice test with timed modules and breaks" or "a question-bank session — check answers as you go", with a time limit, "Attach file", "Your answers are saved as you go. Submit when you're done.", [Finish Homework].
- A teacher dashboard exists at `/teacher`: create class, add students, assign, due dates.
- Other routes: `/question/:key` (probably a public single-question page), `/pricing`, `/feedback`, and admin pages for exam and QBank authoring and import.

## Openings this adds, beyond the teardown

1. **Their study plan is not working right now** (3/3 failures), and its only reschedule is "move later this week".
2. **The report has no skill, difficulty or time per question.** Unanswered counts as "wrong" on one card and not on another. Domain copy is mislabelled. Export is dead.
3. **Achievements and "View All" are empty placeholders.** The streak differs between profile and QOTD. The target score is not shared between wizard, dashboard and profile.
4. **Redo and Save exist in their API but have almost no UI.** A reload loses the per-question timer and the wrong-answer state.
5. **The estimate ignores floor-score sections.** A module-subset sitting never counts as "taken".
